info.name: Microsoft Graph Admin Admin.admin chats.teamsTab API
info.description:
Microsoft Graph API for managing administrative resources in Microsoft Entra ID.
This API enables administrators to manage Microsoft Edge browser settings, Internet Explorer mode configurations,
site lists, shared browser sites, Microsoft 365 Apps installation options, people insights, service announcements,
SharePoint settings, Copilot administration, directory administrative units, and admin consent policies.

Contact Support:
 Name: Microsoft Graph API Support

request.description: The application that is linked to the tab. This can't be changed after tab creation.

item.name: Microsoft Graph Get tab in chat

request.description: Retrieve the properties and relationships of the specified tab in a chat.

item.name: Microsoft Graph Update tab in chat

request.description:
Update the properties of the specified tab in a chat. 
This can be used to configure the content of the tab.

item.name: Microsoft Graph Delete tab from chat

request.description: Remove (unpin) a tab from the specified chat.
